tokens.TITLE: 5a1ive Custom G-Shocks: Inside the Crystal Craft
tokens.META_DESCRIPTION: 5a1ive rebuilds G-Shocks into one-of-one crystal art — hand-set stones, raw amethyst, and CasiOak canvases. Inside the 55555stuff custom watch craft.
tokens.KEYWORDS: 5a1ive, 5a1ive G-Shock, custom G-Shock, crystal G-Shock, CasiOak custom, GA-2100 custom, DW-6900 crystal, 55555stuff, iced G-Shock, DGTL Influence
tokens.DEK: The 5a1ive custom G-Shock isn't a re-coloured Casio — it's a rebuilt object, hand-set with crystals and raw mineral clusters until the watch underneath disappears. Inside the craft that made 55555stuff.
tokens.HERO_CAPTION: A 5a1ive custom G-Shock set with a raw amethyst cluster. Courtesy @5a1ive / 55555stuff.com.
tokens.STAT_FOOTNOTE: Models, pricing and lead time from 55555stuff.com, as of July 2026. Each custom is non-refundable once work has begun.
tokens.LEAD: Look closely at a 5a1ive custom G-Shock and the base watch is almost an afterthought. The Toronto designer, working as 55555stuff, takes a stock Casio — a GA-2100 CasiOak, a DW-6900, a GW-6900 — and hand-sets it under crystals, rhinestones and raw mineral clusters until the case is a landscape rather than a bezel.
tokens.BODY_1: That's the difference between augmenting and rebuilding. A pale-purple GA-2100 vanishes under packed lilac stones; a DW-5600 wears a chunk of raw amethyst like a geode split open on the wrist; a red DW-6900 is set edge to edge until it glints like a ring. The Casio DNA is still there — the octagonal CasiOak silhouette, the square 5600 face — but softened, weighted and made strange.
tokens.BODY_2: The 55555stuff process is deliberately collaborative but firmly authored: a customer buys a model, picks a base colour, and shares a loose direction — then 5a1ive conceptualises and executes with full creative freedom. "Every 5a1ive custom is a one-of-one original," the store states plainly, and orders are non-refundable once the build starts. It's a commission model, not a product catalogue, and it's why no two pieces on the wall are the same.
tokens.PULLQUOTE: The base colour is a starting point. Everything after it is 5a1ive.
tokens.H2_2: The canvases: CasiOak, DW-6900, GAV01 and beyond
tokens.BODY_3: The GA-2100 CasiOak is, in the brand's words, the most-requested canvas — the octagonal case is the perfect field for dense stone-setting. From there the range runs to the GW-6900, the GAV01, the DW-5600, and one-offs like the sculptural Bey Blade build. Prices sit around $500–$600 USD depending on the model and the complexity of the set. Browse the current builds on the 55555stuff G-Shock collection.
tokens.CALLOUT_1: The watch is treated as raw canvas, not a base to accessorise.
tokens.CALLOUT_2: Raw crystal clusters — amethyst, quartz — set alongside packed stones.
tokens.CALLOUT_3: Customer colour and brief in; full creative control out.
tokens.CALLOUT_4: One-of-one and handmade, with a 2–3 week lead time.
tokens.BODY_4: It adds up to a product that photographs like jewellery and wears like armour — the reason 5a1ive builds keep ending up on artists and athletes rather than in a display case, and why a series like the Bey Blade-fused G-Shock keeps going viral on his verified @5a1ive. The craft is the marketing.
tokens.STATCALLOUT_CAP: The most-requested canvas. The octagonal CasiOak case is the field 5a1ive returns to most — dense enough to disappear under a full crystal set.

tokens.FAQ_A1: A 5a1ive custom G-Shock is a one-of-one Casio watch rebuilt by the Toronto designer behind 55555stuff, hand-set with crystals and raw mineral clusters. The base model and colour are chosen by the customer; 5a1ive designs and builds the rest.
tokens.FAQ_Q2: How much does a custom 5a1ive G-Shock cost?
tokens.FAQ_A2: Custom G-Shocks start around $500 USD and run to roughly $600 for more complex builds like the Bey Blade G-Shock. Each is handmade to order with a 2–3 week lead time and is non-refundable once work begins.
tokens.FAQ_A3: The most-requested canvas is the GA-2100 CasiOak. 5a1ive also works the GW-6900, GAV01, DW-5600 and DW-6900, among others, plus sculptural one-offs.
tokens.FAQ_Q4: How do you order a 5a1ive custom?
tokens.FAQ_A4: You buy a model on 55555stuff.com, then contact 5a1ive via Instagram (@5a1ive / @55555stuff) to choose your colour and collaborate on crystals and design before the piece is handcrafted and shipped.
tokens.PERSON_DESC: Toronto-based designer behind 55555stuff, known for one-of-one crystal-augmented custom G-Shock watches.
